patterns.note: The hero section features an asymmetric, collage-like arrangement of illustrative elements and text snippets scattered around a central, large script name, creating a dynamic and playful visual field.

A strong typographic contrast is used, pairing a large, expressive handwritten script for the main name with bold, uppercase sans-serif fonts for section titles and navigation, and a monospaced sans-serif for body text and labels.

The site uses a vibrant and high-contrast color palette, combining a soft, light background with bold primary and secondary colors (blue, pink, green) for accents, section backgrounds, and interactive elements.

The navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport across all pages. The hero section implies interactive motion with a 'DRAG TO MOVE' hint and numerous floating, illustrative elements, suggesting user-initiated animation rather than scroll-triggered page reveals.
The footer is a prominent, two-tone block of solid color (blue and pink) featuring large, bold navigation links and contact information, acting as a distinct visual anchor at the bottom of the page.

technique_notes: To rebuild the interactive hero, use CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library to create a dynamic, floating effect for various illustrative elements around the central name, with potential for user interaction like dragging. The navigation bar should be implemented with a sticky position to remain visible on scroll.

Achieve the high-contrast color blocking by using full-width sections with solid, vibrant background colors that starkly differentiate content areas and provide strong backdrops for white or dark text.

Implement the mixed typography by carefully selecting a script font for display, a bold sans-serif for headings and calls to action, and a monospaced font for body copy and labels, ensuring clear hierarchy and visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, expressive script font for the hero name (~8x body) contrasts with large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3x body) and a smaller, legible monospaced body text.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners for structural elements, with organic and rounded shapes appearing within the illustrative components.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and scattered in the hero section, creating a sense of playfulness, transitioning to a more balanced and structured density in subsequent content sections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly illustrative and interactive hero section, which eschews a traditional static layout for a dynamic, collage-like arrangement of floating elements and a prominent, handwritten name. This creates an immediate impression of creativity and playfulness, setting it apart from typical portfolio sites.
